name: ACC Ltd
title: ACC Ltd - 500410 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: ACC's combined Ambuja-group call reset FY27 volume to ~80 Mt (+8%) and capex to Rs6,000-6,500 cr, with cost peaking at Rs4,500/t in March and a Rs250/t cut targeted, but no price recovery yet.

utilisation.quote: Sanghi still remains at around, say, at 57% on cement capacity utilization, while Penna is 46%

capex.quote: it makes sense to push a little bit of the capex, but without losing eyesight on the overall, say, market share

triggers.label: FY27 capex Rs6,000-6,500 cr
triggers.quote: for FY '27, we are keeping an estimate of almost INR6,000 crores to INR6,500 crores

triggers.label: Sanghi 57%, Penna 46% utilisation
triggers.quote: Sanghi still remains at around, say, at 57% on cement capacity utilization, while Penna is 46%

triggers.label: March prices up only ~Rs10/bag
triggers.quote: Otherwise, ballpark for the quarter of March, around ballpark INR10.

triggers.label: Industry growth 5-5.5% FY27
triggers.quote: the industry may grow at around, say, 5% to 5.5%

triggers.label: Capacity end-state timeline pushed to FY30
triggers.quote: the target plans of FY '28, it could move a year or 2, let us say, on a safer side, I would say that FY '30

guidance.quote: On our overall consol volumes, we are expecting it to grow in FY '28 -- '27 by almost, say, 8% to around 80 million -odd tonnes.
cost, we are looking at roughly INR250 a tonne reduction this year and then another reduction of INR250 next year as well.
We are expecting to hit capacity of almost 119 million tonnes by end of FY '27.
for FY '27, we are keeping an estimate of almost INR6,000 crores to INR6,500 crores
Sanghi is concerned, I will peg myself at almost like 65% to 70%. And so far as Penna is concerned, I will consider around 55% to 60%

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are closer to INR4,100 a tonne.
we are moving away from the time line

red_flags.label: Cost guidance miss and cost peak claim
red_flags.quote: we are closer to INR4,100 a tonne

red_flags.label: Acquired-asset breakdowns and capex delays
red_flags.quote: we've not been able to deliver projects in the stipulated time

red_flags.label: Negative operating cash flow / receivables from Ambuja
red_flags.quote: ACC will find negative operating cash flow

evasions.quote: I think any guidance on EBITDA will be difficult at this stage.
it would be inappropriate from my side to answer anything on that

read.hedge_index_note: Heavy hedging on cost and pricing
